note: Literature explicitly notes that a patient reported by Popov et al. co-carried an SCN8A variant, supporting potential confounding of phenotype attribution.

evidence.text: Wan et al. noted that while Popov et al. reported on YWHAZ, the patient in that report also carried a variant in SCN8A.

source.title: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global developmental delay with brain malformation
source.quote: Ivan K. Popov et al. had reported that YWHAZ … ; however, the patient also carried SCN8A variant in that case (9).
